cost_model: 原v002分项费用+5/15bps不利滑点；原币无借贷整手
history_role: 2023-2026已看历史，仅探索诊断；无独立样本外
selection: 全部保留；不凭这8账户反选赢家或改变旧cash选择
deviations: 原文同收盘成交、无税费/滑点；本地次一真实开盘并扣费
原文总回报指数和国库券现金收益；本地公开事件构造因果总回报，现金利息0
信号月末；既有现金引擎每天按净目标和5%权益交易带调仓，非原文逐笔等同复现
vol12为预登记本地风险覆盖消融，非作者原策略
limitations: Only SPY/QQQ/2800 retrospectively selected ETFs. Not market-wide stocks; historical constituents, delistings and survivorship coverage missing.

Public Yahoo events and US prices, Tencent HK prices. Longbridge authentication, historical lot changes and corporate-action completeness remain unverified. Splits reject rather than invent adjustment.
Dividend ex-date receivables are never spendable; actual payment date, collection fees and investor tax treatment unknown. US 30% haircut is a scenario.
Three exchange-session sale-cash lock is a conservative research buffer, not a certified bank settlement calendar or broker buying-power rule.
Commission/minimum fees are fixed research scenarios; statutory components use dated official rules with conservative per-order rounding. Broker pass-through/charge-date mapping unverified.
Prior20 daily volume cap and 5/15bps slippage are capacity proxies, not opening-auction liquidity or orderbook proof; Tencent volume units not independently certified.
Daily low equity envelope plus exit reserve is not synchronized intraday maximum drawdown. Stocks use 252-session zero-risk-free Sharpe; cash interest not modeled.
Fundamental value/quality, issuer events and macro routing require point-in-time data; no synthetic proxies or returns supplied. FX, short, borrow and leverage disabled.
